name: integrity-seed
description: Catalogs workspace memory and events into bounded, source-linked continuity for Codex agents.

interface.shortDescription: Fast, source-linked memory for Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Catalogs decisions, observations, handoffs, and task events so each supported Codex task begins with fast, bounded access to relevant recorded memory. Local-first by default; secure multi-agent deployments use a separately operated authenticated server transport.
defaultPrompt: Initialize Integrity memory for this workspace.
Explain which recorded events shaped this task.
Plan a secure multi-agent Integrity deployment.
